purpose: Explain the confirmed first-day excursion to Sapo in the one active four-day Canaima program, its differences from Hacha and Angel Falls, inclusions, lodge variants, wet-rock safety, and trip selection.

externalSources.supports: Canaima protected area's World Heritage designation in 1994, tepui landscapes and natural geography.

notes: One confirmed active four-day tour includes Sapo in day one with Hacha; excursion to Angel Falls is on day two.
Passage behind Sapo depends on water levels and safety decisions by local guides. No guaranteed access.
